meta.source: Computed by India Atlas from RBI DBIE (amounts) and MoSPI NAS (GDP)
meta.base: India Atlas ratio over the NSO back series of 2011-12-base GDP
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.
meta.coverage: Deficits, interest, taxes, spending and debt as a share of GDP on one ruler, 1970-71 to 2010-11: the RBI's rupee figures over MoSPI's back-cast of the 2011-12 GDP series
meta.note: Computed here: the accounts in the RBI's rupee tables divided by GDP at current market prices from the NSO's back series on the 2011-12 base (gdp-back-levels). India Atlas arithmetic, not an RBI ratio and not an agency link: its own ruler, never joined to the RBI's printed ratios. From 2011-12 the RBI's published ratios are on this same series (checked: our division reproduces its GFD ratio), so this bundle stops at 2010-11. Different from the RBI's published ratios for these years, which divide by the GDP series of the time (1999-2000 and 2004-05 bases).

centre_gross_fiscal_deficit.name: centre_gross_fiscal_deficit_pct_gdp
centre_gross_fiscal_deficit.label: Centre: gross fiscal deficit, per cent of GDP (computed)
centre_gross_fiscal_deficit.derivedNote: The Centre's gross fiscal deficit as the RBI prints it in rupees (DBIE report 713), divided by MoSPI's GDP at current prices, the NSO's back series on the 2011-12 base; computed by India Atlas, not an RBI ratio.
